            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        你还在纠结FastAPI该用同步还是异步吗？本文从实战出发，带你梳理SQLAlchemy 2.0核心变化，手把手完成同步与异步的完整CRUD，剖析常见陷阱与最佳实践。少走一半弯路，读完就能上手。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">你是不是也遇到过这样的场景——FastAPI 项目一开始用同步写得好好的，接口响应压测也漂亮，后来心血来潮想全面拥抱异步，结果 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">Session</strong> 报错、延迟加载直接炸了，甚至连一个简单的 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">refresh</strong> 都能把你卡半天？</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">今天这篇，就是想跟你好好聊聊，在 FastAPI 里用 SQLAlchemy 做 CRUD，同步和异步到底怎么玩、怎么选、怎么避开那些让人头秃的深坑。🎯</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)"><span style="font-size: 24px">📌 本文能帮你解决什么</span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">• 彻底搞懂 SQLAlchemy 2.0 的核心变化，告别旧式 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">Column</strong> 写法</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">• 搭建同步/异步双引擎，掌握连接池的最佳配置</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">• 亲手写出通用 CRUD，从单条插入到复杂关联查询全涵盖</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">• 给出“同步还是异步”的务实答案，让你不再盲目跟风</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">• 奉上我踩过的坑和排查清单，出了问题可以直接照单抓药</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🧭 内容主要脉络</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">🔹 问题与背景：异步真的更快吗？</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px">🔹 核心原理：从模型定义到引擎配置</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px">🔹 实战 CRUD：增删改查 + 高级查询</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px">🔹 事务与异常：显式边界 + FastAPI 依赖注入</span><br><span style="font-size: 16px">🔹 注意事项：同步异步共存策略 &amp; 常见翻车现场</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🐢 第一部分：问题与背景——你其实不用那么焦虑</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">先说一个反直觉的结论：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">异步不会自动让你的接口变快</strong>。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">如果你的接口只是查一下数据库然后返回，计算量很小，那同步和异步的性能差距微乎其微。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">真正让异步闪光的是高并发 I/O 密集场景——比如你的服务要同时请求多个外部 API、读写大量 WebSocket，这时候异步才能把事件循环的优势发挥出来。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">很多团队一上来就非异步不可，结果发现 SQLAlchemy 1.x 时代异步支持根本是半残废，各种 hack，维护得想哭。2.0 之后异步终于能打了，但也有一堆前置条件。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">所以，<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">简单项目、低并发、团队对异步不熟</strong>，同步完全够用。如果你正准备起一个新项目，而且能保证全链路异步（<span style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">FastAPI + async DB driver + 异步任务队列</span>），那上异步很香。否则，别给自己找麻烦。</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">⚙️ 第二部分：核心原理与基础配置</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">SQLAlchemy 2.0 把声明式映射彻底革新了。现在模型定义长这样：</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50))
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(default=1)  # 乐观锁版本号</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">老式的 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">Column()</strong> 也能用，但我强烈建议你全部换上 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">Mapped + mapped_column</strong> ，类型提示更清晰，IDE 提示也舒服多了。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">接下来是引擎配置，<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">同步</strong>和<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">异步</strong>的差别主要在这：</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code># 同步引擎
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

sync_engine = create_engine(
    "postgresql://user:pass@localhost/db",
    pool_size=20,
    max_overflow=10,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
)
SyncSessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=sync_engine)

# 异步引擎
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, async_sessionmaker, AsyncSession

async_engine = create_async_engine(
    "postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@localhost/db",
    pool_size=20,
    max_overflow=10,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
)
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(async_engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">你可能会问：为毛异步 URL 要变成 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">postgresql+asyncpg</strong> ？因为 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">asyncpg</strong> 是真正的异步驱动，psycopg2 是同步的，混用必定翻车。MySQL 用户请选 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">aiomysql</strong>。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">连接池参数 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">pool_size</strong> 和 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">max_overflow</strong> 在两种模式下意义一样，记得加上 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">pool_pre_ping=True</strong> ，防止连接被数据库回收后应用还傻傻复用。</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🛠️ 第三部分：全程实战——CRUD 一把梭</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">下面我会同步异步对照着写，你会发现核心逻辑几乎一样，<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">区别只在于 async/await 关键字和会话对象</strong>。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">✅ CREATE 操作</strong></span></h3>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code># 同步单条插入
def create_user_sync(session, name: str):
    user = User(name=name)
    session.add(user)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(user)  # 获取数据库生成字段
    return user

# 异步单条插入
async def create_user_async(session: AsyncSession, name: str):
    user = User(name=name)
    session.add(user)
    await session.commit()
    await session.refresh(user)  # 千万别忘 await
    return user</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">批量插入时， <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">add_all</strong> 很直观，但对于大数据量，我更喜欢 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">bulk_insert_mappings</strong> ，速度快得多。<br>但注意：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">异步下 bulk 操作不支持自动刷新和关系绑定</strong>，用完记得手动 commit。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><strong><span style="font-size: 16px; color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">🛎️ async with session.begin() 事务管理</span></strong></h3>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code># 异步批量插入最佳实践：使用 async with session.begin() 
# 更新和删除同理，写操作一律用 begin() 管事务，读操作直接用裸 session（因为读一般不需要事务边界）
async def bulk_create_users(session: AsyncSession, names: list[str]):
    async with session.begin():
        session.add_all([User(name=n) for n in names])
    # 事务已提交，无需显式 commit
    
# 当然，同步时也可使用 with session.begin() 事务自动提交，user 已持有数据库生成字段</code></pre>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">✅ READ 操作</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">主键查询用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">session.get()</strong> ，简单粗暴。高级查询统一用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">select()</strong> 构造，再也没 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">query()</strong> 什么事了。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>from sqlalchemy import select, and_, or_, func
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

# 异步条件查询 + 排序 + 分页
async def search_users(session: AsyncSession, keyword: str, page: int, size: int):
    stmt = (
        select(User)
        .where(User.name.ilike(f"%{keyword}%"))
        .order_by(User.id.desc())
        .limit(size)
        .offset((page - 1) * size)
    )
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    return result.scalars().all()</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">关联查询时，强烈建议<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">显式预加载</strong>，用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">selectinload</strong> 或 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">joinedload</strong> 把 N+1 问题扼杀在摇篮里。<br></span><span style="font-size: 16px">异步下尤其注意，懒加载属性一访问就会抛出 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">MissingGreenlet</strong> 错误，血的教训啊。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>stmt = select(User).options(selectinload(User.posts)).where(User.id == uid)</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">聚合查询用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">func</strong> ：</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>stmt = select(func.count(User.id)).where(User.name.like("%小%"))
total = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar()</code></pre>
<h3 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🧩 再来一个复杂综合案例：搜索用户及其文章统计</h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">需求：搜用户名或邮箱包含关键词的活跃用户，带出他们发表的文章数量，按文章数降序，分页。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>async def search_users_with_post_count(
    session: AsyncSession,
    keyword: str,
    page: int = 1,
    size: int = 10,
):
    # 子查询：每篇文章所属作者
    post_count_sub = (
        select(Post.author_id, func.count(Post.id).label("post_count"))
        .group_by(Post.author_id)
        .subquery()
    )
    
    # 主查询：用户 left join 文章统计
    stmt = (
        select(User, func.coalesce(post_count_sub.c.post_count, 0).label("post_count"))
        .outerjoin(post_count_sub, User.id == post_count_sub.c.author_id)
        .where(
            and_(
                User.is_active == True,
                or_(
                    User.username.ilike(f"%{keyword}%"),
                    User.email.ilike(f"%{keyword}%"),
                ),
            )
        )
        .order_by(desc("post_count"))   # 按别名排
        .limit(size)
        .offset((page - 1) * size)
    )
    
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    rows = result.all()
    
    return [
        {"user": row.User, "post_count": row.post_count}
        for row in rows
    ]</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">这个案例一口气用上了 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">子查询、outerjoin、and_/or_、ilike、coalesce、别名排序、分页</strong>，基本上日常查询的"天花板难度"也就这样了。你把它拆开看，每一块都是前面讲过的基础零件拼起来的。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">✅ UPDATE 操作</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">方式一：查出对象，改属性，commit。直观，适合小更新。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">方式二：批量更新 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">update()</strong> ，直接发 SQL，不经过 ORM 对象。适合批量改状态。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>from sqlalchemy import update

async def deactivate_users(session: AsyncSession, user_ids: list[int]):
    async with session.begin():
        stmt = update(User).where(User.id.in_(user_ids)).values(active=False)
        result = await session.execute(stmt)
        return result.rowcount</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">再说个容易被忽略的：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">乐观锁更新</strong>。利用版本号字段 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">version</strong> ，修改时带上版本条件，防止并发覆盖。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>stmt = (
    update(User)
    .where(User.id == uid, User.version == old_version)
    .values(name=new_name, version=old_version + 1)
)
result = await session.execute(stmt)
if result.rowcount == 0:
    raise Exception("数据已被修改，请重试")</code></pre>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">✅ DELETE 操作</strong></span></h3>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>from sqlalchemy import delete

async def remove_user(session: AsyncSession, uid: int):
    async with session.begin():
        stmt = delete(User).where(User.id == uid)
        await session.execute(stmt)</code></pre>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🔐 第四部分：事务与异常——别把连接池打爆了</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">在 FastAPI 中，我习惯用依赖注入管理会话生命周期，这样每个请求都会自动获取、自动关闭。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>async def get_db():
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        try:
            yield session
            await session.commit()
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            await session.close()</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">关键一条：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">显式事务边界</strong>。哪怕你用了依赖注入，也建议在业务逻辑里用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">async with session.begin()</strong> 包裹写操作，这样出错了自动回滚，绝对不会出现连接未释放的惨案。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">有时候你需要设置事务隔离级别，特别是报表类查询，加 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">with_for_update()</strong> 或修改 session 连接参数就行，异步下完全一致。</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🔄 第五部分：同步异步共存——俩种方案，一个原则</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">项目大了，难免有遗留模块还在同步，新的又想用异步。怎么搞？</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">如果在异步路由里调用同步数据库方法，可以用 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">asyncio.to_thread</strong> 把同步操作扔进线程池，避免阻塞事件循环。</span></p>
<pre class="language-python highlighter-hljs"><code>import asyncio

async def async_endpoint():
    user = await asyncio.to_thread(sync_get_user, user_id=1)
    return user</code></pre>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">反过来，在同步路由里调异步方法，千万<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">别用 asyncio.run()</strong> ，它会新建事件循环，和 FastAPI 当前循环冲突，结果就是玄学报错。要么老实用同步，要么把整个路由改成 async。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">归根结底，我的建议是：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">新项目从一开始就全异步栈</strong>——FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async + asyncpg/aiomysql。即使现在并发不高，也能免去未来重构的痛苦。</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">💣 第六部分：常见翻车现场 &amp; 排查指南</h2>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">1. 异步 refresh 前没 await</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">现象：获取不到数据库默认值或自增 ID。<br>原因： <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">session.refresh()</strong> 是协程，必须 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">await</strong> 。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">2. MissingGreenlet 错误</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">现象：异步会话访问懒加载属性直接炸。<br>解决：把所有要用的关联全部 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">selectinload</strong> 或 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">joinedload</strong> 。别偷懒。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">3. 连接池耗尽</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">现象：突然所有请求卡住，日志显示“等待连接超时”。<br>大概率是事务没关闭，连接一直占着。马上检查是否有 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">commit/rollback</strong> 缺失。</span></p>
<h3 style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">4. 同步异步引擎混用</strong></span></h3>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">现象：在同一个模块里不小心把异步 session 传给了同步方法。<br>对策：严格分层，文件名带 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">_sync</strong> 或 <strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">_async</strong> 后缀，写清楚。</span></p>
<h2 style="color: rgba(44, 62, 80, 1)">🏁 总结：别让选择本身变成负担</h2>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">说到底，CRUD 就是那几个固定动作，2.0 的 API 也帮我们抹平了很多心智负担。同步还是异步，真正要看的只有两件事：<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">你的并发模型</strong>和<strong style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">团队的肌肉记忆</strong>。选定一套栈，写清楚规范，然后沉下心写业务就好。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(85, 85, 85, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2"><span style="font-size: 16px">老规矩，如果这篇文章帮你少踩了一个坑，或者帮你下定了用同步/异步的决心，<strong><span style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">点个</span><span style="color: rgba(186, 55, 42, 1)">赞加关注</span></strong>不过分吧？☺️ 转发给那个还在纠结的同事，说不定会请你喝奶茶呢。🙌</span></p>

</div>
